defs.def: that cannot be found or that is not in its usual place, or at home 找不到的；不在的；丢失的

ex.s: Scents of the missing plants are preserved in the atmosphere.
ex.t: 森林和雪的气味变化有一个共同的潜在原因。

ex.s: If you’ve never experienced the “sunshine scent” from a sheet or shirt ____65____ (leave) to sun for a day, well, you’re missing out on one of life’s wonders.
ex.t: 学生在注册期间需要做什么？

ex.s: One day, during a class in the IT lab with my classmates, our teacher mentioned missing computer parts. ____2____ looks exchanged, everyone wondered how it could happen in a(n) ____3____ lab.
ex.t: 在以下哪个日期你可以取消报名并获得全额退款？

ex.s: The following day, called to the headmaster’s office, I found myself accused of stealing the missing parts.
ex.t: 五年前我开始转向零浪费生活方式时就经历了这种情况，当时我和父母住在一起；现在我和丈夫一起生活时也继续经历这种情况，因为他并不像我一样完全零浪费。

ex.s: With so many online posts featuring the same places, it’s easy to feel like you’re missing out.
ex.t: 网上有那么多展示同一批地方的帖子，你很容易觉得自己错过了什么。

ex.s: Most trains operate just once a day and some run only three times a week, so missing yours can be a disaster. ____39____ Note: The times listed on the schedules are departure times, not arrival times.
ex.t: 大多数火车每天只运行一班，有些一周只运行三次，所以错过你的火车可能是一场灾难。____39____注意：时刻表上列出的是发车时间，不是到达时间。

ex.s: Asking about “the point” of ALife might be, well, missing the point entirely, he says.
ex.t: 询问ALife的"意义"可能——嗯——完全偏离了重点，他说。

ex.s: You’ll be informed by email if you are being deregistered as a result of missing sessions.
ex.t: 如果你因缺课而被取消注册，我们会通过电子邮件通知你。

ex.s: All kinds of human emotions are on display: sad (tearful goodbyes), happy (family get-togethers), anxious (waiting in a long line) and upset (missing a flight).
ex.t: 各种人类情感在这里展现：悲伤（含泪告别）、快乐（家庭团聚）、焦虑（排长队等候）和沮丧（错过航班）。

ex.s: are anxious about missing their flights
ex.t: 担心错过航班

ex.s: It went missing.
ex.t: 它失踪了。

ex.s: If you see humor as an optional form of entertainment, you’re missing some of its biggest benefits: Humor makes average-looking people look cute and uninteresting people seem entertaining.
ex.t: 如果你把幽默看作一种可选的娱乐形式，你就错过了它最大的好处：幽默让长相普通的人看起来可爱，让无趣的人看起来有趣。

ex.s: Before hearing from Zac, Adeline hadn’t realized the medal was missing.
ex.t: 在收到扎克的来信之前，阿德琳并没有意识到勋章丢失了。

ex.s: As    65    result, people will eat more food to try to make up for that something missing.
ex.t: 作为____结果，人们会吃更多的食物来弥补那种缺失感。

ex.s: At first, I really felt I was missing out.
ex.t: 起初，我真的觉得自己错过了什么。

ex.s: His research shows that this is often missing for people with mental health conditions.
ex.t: 费用很可能比一间卧室的租金便宜得多。

defs.def: that has been removed, lost or destroyed and has not been replaced 被去除的；丢失的；被损毁的；缺少的

ex.s: had been missingB. were missing
ex.t: 几个月后，当我在自己的实验室重复这个实验时，我产出了更多可发表的数据。

ex.s: When fat and salt     64     (remove) from food, the food tastes as if is missing something.
ex.t: 当脂肪和盐被从食物中____（去除）时，食物尝起来好像缺了点什么。

ex.s: By the fifth day, she realised that she hadn’t been missing out on anything.
ex.t: 到了第五天，她意识到自己没有错过任何东西。

ex.s: Tuesdays with Morrie Despite being a sports journalist with a successful career ahead of him, Mitch Albom feels that there is something missing from his life.
ex.t: 《相约星期二》尽管米奇\u00b7阿尔博姆是一名前途光明的体育记者，但他觉得生活中缺少了什么。

defs.def: not present after an accident, battle, etc. but not known to have been killed 人

ex.s: have been missingD. will be missing
ex.t: 通过学会何时寻求帮助，我终于踏上了成为独立科学家的道路。

ex.s: But Moore was sick of missing out on candies.
ex.t: 一切始于摩尔和她爸爸一起去银行的时候。

ex.s: Her head and arms are missing, but you can imagine her holding her arms up high, celebrating the result of an ancient battle.
ex.t: 她的头和手臂都没有了，但你可以想象她高举双臂，庆祝一场古代战役的胜利。

defs.def: not included, often when it should have been 缺少的；未被包括在内的

ex.s: I often leave early to seek the right destinations so I can set up early to avoid missing the moment I am attempting to photograph.
ex.t: 我经常早早出发去寻找合适的目的地，这样我可以提前架好设备，避免错过我想拍摄的瞬间。

ex.s: My mobile phone was inside, but luckily there was a telephone box across the street.
ex.t: 手机在里面，但幸运的是街对面有一个电话亭。

ex.s: These days you'd be hard pressed to find anyone in Australia over the age of 15 who doesn’t own a mobile phone.
ex.t: 实际上几乎任何人都可以随时随地打电话和接电话。

ex.s: Generation Xers with young families, like my wife and I, can still find it convenient to have a home phone rather than providing a mobile phone for every family member.
ex.t: 你对座机的依赖程度如何？

ex.s: After becoming an important part of many British streets, the phone boxes began disappearing in the 1980s, with the rise of the mobile phone sending most of them away to the junkyards.
ex.t: 它们由伦敦巴特西发电站的设计师Giles Gilbert Scott设计。

ex.s: By the fifth day, I wondered-was I really missing out by not constantly checking my phone to see what everyone else was up to?
ex.t: 到了第五天，我在想——不经常查看手机看别人都在做什么，我真的错过了什么吗？
